description: One resource's totals (CPU in cores, memory in bytes): what the pods ask for, use and are held to, and what the nodes can give them.

requests.description: What the pods ask for (their containers' requests).

used.description: What they use now (the metrics API's), or null without one.

limits.description: What they're held to (the limits their containers set), or null when none sets one.

allocatable.description: What the nodes can give pods, or null when the nodes can't be listed.

cells.description: requests, used, limits and allocatable as they're shown.

shares.description: requests, used and limits as shares of allocatable (28%), or empty.
